units_policy: Use explicit schema units; model lengths are normally metres and rotations degrees. Display length_unit does not rescale model coordinates.
checks_policy: Only invoke existing checks advertised by current discovery. Research records and geometry helpers do not establish executable checks.
review_scope: Complete source-backed protocol schemas, operation/action examples and focused local validation. Public release and comparative/client upgrade acceptance remain separate.
visual_checks_policy: Require an available agent-controlled browser with screenshots. project_view returns a synchronous exact-target read-only client viewport URL; after a completed Save reload the same tab and verify readiness, loaded revision receipt and screenshot. MCP access alone does not establish browser capability; no backend PNG fallback.
